name: sg-llm-infographic
description: SVG infographic extractor and renderer. Listens for LLM streaming chunks and final response, extracts the first <svg>…</svg> block, and renders it live. Style presets (executive/technical/playful/minimal/bold/data). Export to SVG or PNG.
notes: Uses Shadow DOM. getSystemPrompt() returns the style-specific system prompt for the reality's system block. PNG export uses Canvas API (requires browser context). SVG sanitised against <script> and inline event handlers.
